tonight: Athens still. Lazy day in the city — alleys if we feel like it, nowhere we have to be.
tomorrow: More of Athens. Same easy pace.

postcard.title: Looking up
postcard.note: Julia and Daniel looking at the Parthenon. The high city, finally under our feet.
postcard.caption: Julia and Daniel looking at the Parthenon. Twenty-four centuries, and it still does the looking-up.

word.meaning: Plaka. The old neighborhood under the rock — alleys, cafés, and a day with nowhere to rush.
